highlights.title: Uber to Cut 3,300 Jobs in Company Overhaul to Reduce Management Layers
highlights.description: Uber Technologies Inc. is cutting about 3,300 roles, or 10% of its staff globally, in a massive restructuring aimed at reducing management layers and reallocating spending into its ride-sharing, delivery and robotaxi businesses.

highlights.title: Apple tells Mac App Store developers they can now drop Intel support
highlights.description: Apple started informing developers today that universal macOS apps on the Mac App Store that require macOS 13 or later can now drop support for Intel-based Macs. more…

highlights.title: Lyte Closes $165 Million Round, Bringing AI Startup's Valuation to $1.6 Billion
highlights.description: Lyte, a fast-growing robotics and artificial intelligence startup from top members of Apple Inc.'s Face ID team, has secured about $165 million in a new funding round that more than triples the company’s valuation to $1.6 billion.

highlights.title: OpenAI says its new 'Astra' AI can build attacks without human help
highlights.description: Astra is the first OpenAI model to reach its “Critical” cybersecurity threshold, meaning it can find previously unknown vulnerabilities and develop ways to exploit them across hardened systems.

highlights.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.’s need for chipmaking tools has nearly doubled since the end of last year as it expands production to meet AI demand, a senior executive said.

chips_cloud.title: Acer’s wild Project DualPlay Mini is a foldable handheld that doubles as a netbook — concept shown alongside Predator Atlas 7 handheld sporting Intel’s Arc G-series chip
chips_cloud.description: Using the recent Predator Atlas 8 as a blueprint, Acer revealed the smaller Atlas 7 alongside a unique concept called Project DualPlay Mini at IFA 2026.

chips_cloud.title: GPTC CEO on Business Strategy, Chip Industry
chips_cloud.description: Hoton Chang, Chairman and CEO at GPTC, discusses the company's business strategy and the demand for advanced packaging in the semiconductor industry. He speaks with Stephen Engle from the sidelines of SEMICON Taiwan in Taipei. (Source: Bloomberg)

chips_cloud.title: SEMI CEO on Memory Prices, Semiconductor Supercycle
chips_cloud.description: Ajit Manocha, President and CEO of semiconductor industry association SEMI, discusses the outlook for memory chip prices and the ongoing supercycle in the semiconductor market. He speaks with Stephen Engle on the sidelines of SEMICON Taiwan in Taipei. (Source: Bloomberg)

chips_cloud.title: Phison Electronics Sees Worst NAND Shortage in 2027
chips_cloud.description: Phison Electronics Corporation Co-Founder and CEO KS Pua believes NAND flash memory may face its worst shortage next year. He also discusses NAND's role in artificial intelligence. Phison Electronics designs, makes and sells controller chips for NAND flash memory used in solid-state drives , USB drives and memory cards. He speaks with Stephen Engle from the sidelines of 'Semicon Taiwan 2026'. (Source: Bloomberg)

chips_cloud.title: AI data center investment projected to hit $32 trillion by 2050 — infrastructure spending estimated to exceed capital requirements for railways, electrification, or the internet
chips_cloud.description: These investments aren't massive one-time expenses — data center operators are expected to upgrade their expensive GPUs and related infrastructure every four to six years, as new semiconductor technologies arrive on the market.

chips_cloud.title: Acer shows off its AI desktop future with the RTX Spark design
chips_cloud.description: It's a showcase of NVIDIA's latest chip tech.

chips_cloud.title: Oklahoma City tries to charge farmer arrested at data center debate $17,000 for body cam footage of the incident — accused faces trespassing charge for going over allotted speaking time by 30 seconds at a public debate
chips_cloud.description: Claremore admits that one of its reasons for charging so much is because it fears that the documents will be "subject to wide distribution, including on social media."

other.title: Microsoft is enabling a Windows 11 security feature that can hurt gaming performance
other.description: Microsoft is getting ready to roll out its memory integrity security feature of Windows 11 to more devices next month. The kernel-level protection feature is designed to stop malicious code or drivers running on a Windows 11 machine, but Microsoft previously warned it can also impact PC gaming performance.
